title: FIREBALL: A Dataset of Dungeons and Dragons Actual-Play with Structured Game State Information
reasoning: The paper introduces a new dataset for Dungeons & Dragons gameplay and evaluates LLM performance on command and narration generation tasks. While D&D inherently involves moral choices and character alignments (e.g., 'NE' for Neutral Evil is mentioned in an appendix example), the paper's focus is on the technical aspects of natural language processing and game state management, not on evaluating or benchmarking the LLM's understanding or generation of content related to religion, morals, or ethics. The mention of filtering profanity/sensitive topics is a preprocessing step for dataset cleanliness, not a core evaluation component.
